# express-controller-sets

> Generate list, read, create, update and delete endpoints for any Mongoose model in one call — with filtering, search, pagination, S3 uploads, authentication and a security model that denies by default.

Install: `npm install express-controller-sets express mongoose`. ES modules, Node 20+, Express 5, Mongoose 9.
For a complete, self-contained guide written for language models, read https://ornate-source.github.io/controllerSets/llms-full.txt.

## Getting started

- [Overview](https://ornate-source.github.io/controllerSets/): Why controller-sets, and how to install it.
- [How to use](https://ornate-source.github.io/controllerSets/how-to-use.html): Build a working products API with createRouter in five steps.

## Guides

- [createRouter](https://ornate-source.github.io/controllerSets/router.html): Every option of createRouter — including file uploads — why you would use it, and every API endpoint it creates.
- [Redis cache](https://ornate-source.github.io/controllerSets/cache.html): Answer repeated reads from Redis in milliseconds — cleared automatically on every write.
- [S3 Upload](https://ornate-source.github.io/controllerSets/uploads.html): Upload files on your own routes with the upload middleware, and connect your bucket.
- [Auth setup](https://ornate-source.github.io/controllerSets/auth.html): Sign-up, login, roles, refresh tokens and social sign-in on your own user model.
- [Email sender](https://ornate-source.github.io/controllerSets/email.html): Send password-reset codes by email or SMS, with your own transporter and templates.
- [.env.example](https://ornate-source.github.io/controllerSets/env.html): Every environment variable, with ready-made setups for common providers.
- [Advanced](https://ornate-source.github.io/controllerSets/advanced.html): Use each ControllerSets method — getAll, query, get, create, update, delete — on your own routes.

## More

- [FAQ](https://ornate-source.github.io/controllerSets/faq.html): Answers to the questions people hit first.
- [Use with an LLM](https://ornate-source.github.io/controllerSets/llm.html): One prompt so ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot write correct code for this package.
